verdict.rationale: Svelte is an open-source UI framework and compiler. It holds no user account data that would need exporting, so a data-export-and-leave story is a category error for this kind of product. The playground-to-project download is a developer scaffolding convenience for individual playgrounds, not an account-wide export of user data, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
